searchText: I have been looking at ETH after being mostly invested in Nano for a while ETH 2.0 has peaked my interest anyone care to discuss? Yes <@494491139085172736> this is a discord channel made entirely for Eth2.0 😂 https://www.dontasktoask.com/ What questions do you have? 😁 I am trying to get my head around Sharding and how it will really work here are some good explainers https://docs.ethhub.io/ethereum-roadmap/ethereum-2.0/sharding/ https://github.com/ethereum/wiki/wiki/Sharding-FAQ <@494491139085172736> Also, check out the devcon videos to learn about ethereum and eth2: https://slideslive.com/ethereum/devcon5 Poor <@494491139085172736> , he's now going to see how deep the rabbit hole goes! And https://eth2.info is good too so much to read <@494491139085172736> here is the tldr from devcon: https://slideslive.com/38919931/eth-20-tldr The tag system is broken on slideslive :/ https://slideslive.com/t/eth-20#!feed=latest no videos appear with the eth2.0 tag even though I just followed the link from Danny's vid Yes, and not all videos show up under ethereum :(. https://slideslive.com/ethereum/devcon5 has the full collection of devcon talks, incl. all eth2 talks and even under his name the devcon TLDR; video doesn't show up as well: https://slideslive.com/s/danny-ryan-13854 I'm curious how you found the Eth 2.0 tldr video by the way, Google doesn't find it for example **protolambda** Under collections tab in that link I just posted, scroll down, lots of videos there So I found Vitalik talk by going through the talk IDs one-by-one on slideslive. It has 0 views ...: https://slideslive.com/38919930/cryptoeconomics-in-30-minutes Because everyone saw it in person or streamed (?) 😬 I personally couldn't attend Devcon this year unfortunately, but had not seen vitalik's video link. 🙂 Just finished your TLDR, now moving on to vitalik's talk 🙂 thanks for the link guys 😄 No, I think slideslive.com have a bug and the split video are not discoverable And streaming during Devcon (at least day1) was not available IIRC (not blaming, I know i can be hard :p) so.. yeah :p See, 2019 only has the 8 hours long videos but if you list fro https://slideslive.com/38919930/ to https://slideslive.com/38919935/ you get some 20min videos. anyway, I guess that's offtopic. Would be nice to know that it's acknowledged by slideslive though <dangerousfood> In the `beacon-chain-validator` spec there is a method `get_eth1_data(distance: uint64) -> Eth1Data`. The value `distance` is described as `relative to the Eth 1.0 head at the start of the current Eth 1.0 voting period`. Is the block number of the Eth1Data being returned equal to `best block - distance`? @dangerousfood, this is my interpretation https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/issues/1439
